title: Polypill for heart failure with reduced ejection fraction: the POLY-HF randomized trial
observations_or_assays: Medication adherence from blood drug concentrations
time_scope: Baseline/month 6 for CMR; the article-defined 6-month clinical-event and adherence windows.
excluded: Full-ITT/imputed CMR, echocardiographic LVEF, responder/subgroup/sensitivity analyses
Other adherence definitions, NT-proBNP, medication dosing and safety
population_or_material: The POLY-HF cohort: the primary modified-ITT CMR analysis and the source-defined clinical-event and adherence analyses.
requested_items: Primary modified-ITT CMR LVEF arm estimates/contrast, HF hospitalization/ED episode rates and rate ratio, and TDM adherence counts/proportions and primary risk ratio/unadjusted test. Exclude death-composite HR, alternate LVEF populations and other endpoints.
